user.title: Android bridge required
user.description: **Without the Samsung Find Bridge app this setup will not work.** Install it on your Samsung phone first: [samsung-find-bridge.apk]({apk_url}). Then click Submit and sign in with your Samsung account in the page that opens on the phone.

authorize.title: Sign in to Samsung
authorize.description: A Samsung sign-in page opens on your phone. Sign in with your Samsung account; Home Assistant continues automatically.

abort.already_configured: This Samsung account is already configured.
abort.auth_expired: The Samsung sign-in session expired. Start setup again.
abort.no_external_url: Home Assistant needs a configured external HTTPS URL for Samsung sign-in.
abort.wrong_account: This is a different Samsung account than the one configured.
